correctness.rationale: The specified cyclic-interval Minkowski sum P_n is a full-dimensional convex graph-associahedron in the affine coordinate-sum hyperplane, invariant under cyclic label shift. Its cyclic barycenter is interior; radial projection of ∂P_n to the sum-zero Euclidean unit sphere is equivariant. For n=kp and prime p≥5, the generator ρ^k has k coordinate p-cycles, so V_n decomposes into R^(k-1) trivial plus k copies of each nonzero real Fourier weight 1,...,(p-1)/2. The moving sphere action is free and its quotient is generalized L_(p,k). S(V)/C_p=S^(k-2)*L_(p,k)≅Σ^(k-1)L for k≥2, while k=1 gives the lens directly. The standard lens cellular chain differentials p and 0 give H_(n-2)=Z and Z/p in degrees k,k+2,...,n-4, with H0=Z. For k=1 lens dimension p-2≥3 gives π1=C_p; for k≥2 suspension connectivity plus Hurewicz gives π_k=Z/p. No composite-order assertion.
